subject.title: fix(matrix): reverse-proxy path support for Matrix homeserver URLs

question: Should Matrix homeserver URL path components be treated as meaningful and preserved for OpenClaw helper requests on upgrade?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but accepting it defines upgrade-sensitive behavior for existing channels.matrix.homeserver values that already contain paths.

options.title: Accept Path-Valued Homeserver Semantics
options.body: Confirm that path-bearing Matrix homeserver URLs are supported and merge this transport-local fix once the current head is refreshed and checks are green.

options.title: Require Broader Live Matrix Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted send/receive, directory, or media round trip through the path-prefixed proxy before accepting the compatibility risk.

options.title: Pause For Config Contract Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if Matrix homeserver paths need a different public contract or explicit documentation before runtime behavior changes.

recommendation.title: Accept Path-Valued Homeserver Semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm that path-bearing Matrix homeserver URLs are supported and merge this transport-local fix once the current head is refreshed and checks are green.
